chapters.title: Abhyanga and oil therapies
chapters.intro: Abhyanga is the synchronised application of warm herbal oil by two therapists, here along the legs, feet, shoulders and scalp. Pizhichil pours the oil from a brass vessel over the body; Udwarthanam works herbal powder into the skin instead of oil.
